title: Backlash
text: Model behavior of system with play, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Initial output} sets the initial output value; {Deadband width} sets the width of the deadband, {Input processing} sets the sample- or frame-based processing Elements and {Enable zero-crossing detection}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Deadband width
params.values: Specify the width of the deadband 1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Initial output
params.values: Specify the initial output value 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Specify sample- or frame-based processing Elements as channels (sample based) (default) | Columns as channels (frame based)
